text: Pre-screen the ten conditional code-review lenses (deployment-infra, reliability, performance, api-contract, adversarial, privacy, docs-clarity, agent-usability, previous-comments, accessibility) with one noul per lens over the diff plus each lens's guidance text; the reasoning model only judges lenses in the uncertain band. Registry already says keyword matching may inform but never select.

Before convening a refute-N verifier panel (N full agent calls at the unit's tier) per finding, ask a noul 'is this finding plausibly refutable / worth a panel' and use the answer as a near-zero-cost extra vote or a pre-screen; never as the sole refutation.
Replace five regex word-lists (security/api/infra/privacy/refactor flags that feed the mandatory test-gate) with regex OR noul, widen-only: a flag is set if either fires.

Classify each planned unit's work shape with a choice question whose state carries the operator's tiering policy verbatim; map shape to {model, effort} in code; batch all units of a plan in one request. Replaces prose-only heuristic applied by the planning model.
Classify each /saga:loop turn as Route / Drive / Resume with a choice call over the operator's input, with a fallback option and a confidence floor below which the model decides.

Suggest the SDLC issue type (capability/enhancement/defect/exploration/context-update) as a choice with the repo's issue-types reference as policy state; show the distribution; auto-apply only above a threshold tuned on the repo's own label history; log operator overrides to build an evaluation set.
Replace the legacy regex auto-label rules with one noul per label (security, testing, tech-debt, documentation) over title+body, thresholded, regex kept as a widen-only union.
Pre-fill the card risk level (low/medium/high/very-high) with a score question over the issue body; still ask the operator when confidence is low.
Suggest the Initiative/Objective project-field value with a choice over the live option list fetched at call time.
Replace the single-word 'review' regex that decides whether a unit is a bespoke review request with a noul over the unit's task text; the docstring already says no regex can carry this decision.
Add a noul 'is this shell command a genuine external-engine invocation' beside the six-substring regex that feeds the real-vs-faked delegation verdict; advisory, surfaces disagreements.
Decide whether a commit deserves a LEARNINGS/DECISIONS nudge with a noul over the commit message and diff stat ('non-obvious fix or pattern decision') instead of the feat/fix prefix regex.
Pre-rank generated ideas with score questions (novelty, grounding, ambition) before the expensive per-idea critique, so the critique budget goes to the top slice; never silently drop ideas.
Cross-check each reviewer finding's self-reported severity/confidence with an independent score question over the finding and the diff hunk; flag large disagreements for the operator.

Ship a `jev tier` command-line tool (task text -> {model, effort, confidence}) in fleet-core that any harness (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen, Antigravity, Grok, Hermes) can shell to when choosing a subagent's model and effort; policy text from CLAUDE.md passed as state.
When generating a dynamic workflow, ask per unit (batched): parallel-safe? needs verify panel? panel size 1/3/5? risk score; code assembles the DAG and panel sizes from the answers.

A PreToolUse hook asks a noul 'does this Bash/Edit call match the current task and respect operator constraints (no force-push, no prod, no secrets)'; block or ask on high probability of violation. Prior art: pi-heed, agent safety monitor.
Rank the ~90 installed skills against the user's prompt with nouls (shortlist) and suggest at most one skill to load; cookbook 'skill suggestion' reports wrong loads 16.8%->7.3%.

Route each main-session turn to a cheaper or stronger model based on a Jev complexity judgment (prior art jev-router). Note: operator policy says the live session model/effort is operator-authoritative.
Score transcript segments for relevance and prune stale context (prior art fast-jev-compaction).
Classify each workstream into Needs Operator / In Progress / Waiting / Parked with a choice over its latest status text at voice-console start and end-of-day closeout.
Map a Herdr session's lifecycle label plus last terminal output to one of seven status words with a choice call.
Classify an incoming problem claim as requirement / suspected gap / verified defect with a choice call, advisory only, before authorizing repair.
Route each knowledge item to LEARNINGS / DECISIONS / QUEUED / ARCHIVE / standalone write-up with a choice call at end-of-day closeout.
Preflight an unattended run with a noul batch: nine decision-completeness questions over the parent issue body and five monitor-misconfiguration patterns over the monitor's recent turns.

After an incoming Lead's first reply, a noul batch checks roster match (one Code Reviewer, two distinct repair roles), scope ambiguity of corrections, and claim-vs-evidence for reported completions; results recorded as a Judgment Provenance section.
Score workspace leak risk from elapsed days (computed in code) plus the last stated reason for keeping it open; surface a ranked list.
Run the Launchable / Capable / Behaves check as three nouls over the launch-surface, benchmark, and observation rows for a proposed roster entry.

Add typesafe_client.py to fleet_commons modelled on engine_bridge_http.py (stdlib urllib, injectable urlopen/getenv/clock, secret resolved once and never logged, closed status vocabulary) plus a CLI, tests with fake urlopen, release-surface bumps.

An evaluation harness: cache answers to JSON, compute agreement against labelled history, plot confidence vs accuracy, pick per-decision thresholds; required before any decision goes from advisory to automatic.

Add a short shared-register section telling every agent when to reach for the jev CLI for a typed judgment (tiering, triage, routing) and when not to (arithmetic, dates, adversarial input, live external state).

Propagate the typesafe-ai skill to Codex and Gemini/Antigravity via `npx skills add typesafe-ai/skills`, to Grok via its marketplace mirror, to Hermes via asgard-skills sync; verify TYPESAFE_API_KEY reaches each harness's subprocesses.
